rule: Every adaptation of ascii.rest code in our engine is listed here with the upstream file it came from. The checker requires both directions: a listed entry must be present in the code (its marker), and library-derived material found in the code must be listed (a constant in the code that is not in a ledger entry fails). The MIT notice is retained at `library.notice`.

entries.what: Build one finished cell per (ramp step, palette ink) once, then copy that cell into each grid cell, instead of blending every pixel of every cell on every frame.
entries.upstream: the canvas atlas: "each (character, colour) pair is drawn once into an atlas and copied from there into its cell, and a frame redraws only the cells that changed since the last one"
improvedBeyond: The key is our ramp step and palette ink rather than a glyph and a colour, so no font, no text atlas and no per-glyph slot bookkeeping is needed.
The sprite set is bounded by the palette (at most 32 inks x 3 steps), so nothing is ever evicted or re-rendered; the upstream atlas has a 1024-slot ceiling with a clear-and-rebuild path.
One atlas serves BOTH outputs: the Node bake path and the live canvas call the same rasteriser, so an optimised blit cannot make baked and live disagree (the hash equality the checks assert).
Measured: 9.48 ms per 200x100 frame at 8 px per cell versus 12.23 ms for the straightforward per-pixel blend on this host, for byte-identical output.

rejected.what: font glyphs as the dot shapes (the library's `fillText` atlas drawn from a monospace font)
rejected.why: Our dots are analytic anti-aliased discs. They do not depend on a font being installed, they measure the same on every host, and the largest step can be held at the measured coverage ladder instead of whatever the font's `bulletsize` turns out to be. Measured on this host: the library's `·` at 4 device px per cell marks 0.125 of a cell's pixels (touched-pixel fraction, red channel; alpha-weighted ink coverage is 0.0539 / 0.139 / 0.4375) and its `●` marks 0.8125, but the same three glyphs mark 0.0625 / 0.1563 / 0.4961 at 16 px per cell, so the glyph ladder is font- and size-dependent.

rejected.what: the library's scene catalogue, its scene colours as our art, and any vendored file
rejected.why: Weight and identity: the recipes closure is entry-point dependent (measured 44,252 B to 305,984 B gzip depending on the entry), and the artwork is the reference, not our brand.
